jobs.name: momentum_x7_bird_plate
jobs.prompt: A vintage natural-history engraving of a single small songbird perched on a bare twig, rendered in fine copperplate line and stipple in warm sepia-black ink, printed on aged cream laid paper with a visible embossed plate-mark rectangle, light foxing spots and softly toned edges. The bird faces right, alert, wings folded. The sheet lies flat on a warm cream cardstock desk, hex #F2EFE9, photographed straight down with soft top-left light, a thin shadow under the sheet's lifted corner. Generous empty paper around the bird. No text, no caption, no plate number.

jobs.name: momentum_x8_scrapbook_opener
jobs.prompt: Top-down scrapbook composition on warm cream cardstock, hex #F2EFE9: three layered torn-edge sheets of cream and pale tan paper with irregular deckled edges, slightly rotated, overlapping. On the top sheet, a small vintage sepia engraving of a songbird in flight on foxed paper, held at two corners by ivory photo corners. A strip of pale gold washi tape, hex #E8D9A8, crosses one corner; a second strip of grey-tan tape crosses another. One small brass brad and one rusted paperclip sit at the edges. A single folded royal blue cardstock triangle, hex #0A3498, with a gold bead at one vertex, rests on the lower right sheet, the only saturated colour in frame. Soft top-left light, real paper shadows between layers, fine grain. The upper left third of the frame is empty cream, clean space. No text.
